description:
The corruption is increasing.




It doesn't touch your computer but corrupt the world with an block
body:
my first horror mod

Created with the help of MCreator

What the mod do:
- Can corrupt the world with an block (yes it spread)
- 3 blocks (one of the block normally send messages on the chat by clicking on it and corrupt your world, one just teleport you into an custom dimension)
- An entity (ptitomboss?) that is bullied by the warden in close fight and will spawn each night 
- An house structure (working on it but an part was release in the version 0.13)
- 2 corrupted biome (one spawn in the overworld, one spawn in the nether, the two combined spawn in the new dimension)
- an dangerous dimension
- Buff certain entities with effects that get an bit stronger every day it pass
- IA assistance (not really)

What the mod can't do:
- Can't create files on your pc
- Can't crash or kick out of your world (yet)
